name: NASA APOD
author: smolamSK
description: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day as your wallpaper, in a theme coloured from the picture

barWidget.description: Today's or a random Astronomy Picture of the Day, with its story and the theme colours taken from it.

schema.label: NASA API key
schema.description: Free from api.nasa.gov, shown right after signing up. shell.json is readable by every user on the computer, so rather leave this empty and save the key privately with `bin/omarchy-apod key` in the plugin folder. With no key at all, the shared DEMO_KEY is used, which runs out quickly.

schema.label: Theme brightness
schema.description: Auto picks a light theme for bright pictures and a dark one for the rest, which is most of the sky.

schema.label: Colour strength
schema.description: How strongly the picture's colours tint the background, accent and terminal colours. Text stays readable at every level.

schema.label: Announce new pictures
schema.description: A notification with the title, credit and NASA's explanation when the picture changes.
